newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's air cargo traffic up 9.2pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Spain's air cargo traffic up 9.2pct in January.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at the 39 airports managed by AENA (Spanish Airports and Air Navegation) rose 9.2 percent in January to 40,603 tonnes, AENA said.
Strong growth in traffic at Palma de Mallorca and Gran Canaria fuelled the increase.
Cargo business at Gran Canaria rose 25.2 percent to 3,927 tonnes in the month, compared with January last year, while Palma handled 25.7 percent more traffic, or 1,325 tonnes.
Madrid saw a rise of 8.2 percent to 19,727 tonnes while Valencia and Tenerife North saw increases of 9.9 and 3.6 percent to 1,025 and 1,397 tonnes respectively.

Passenger numbers at all the AENA airports climbed 7.6 percent last month to 6.77 million, while the number of aircraft movements was 9.0 percent higher at 102,001. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
